question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The** correct answer** is 'Option 1' i.e.** 'wide'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• This sentence requires an adjective to describe the** "range"** of manufacturing processes in which pyridine, as an industrial solvent, is used.
 
• The term** 'wide'** is suitable here as it suggests a large number of different manufacturing processes, or a great variety. 
 
• In this sense, it is** usually used before** a singular noun like **'range'.**
 
• **'Wide'** is the most contextually relevant and grammatically accurate choice among all given options to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the** correct answer **is 'Option 1' i.e. **'wide'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Wider' **is the comparative form of 'wide' and is used when there are at least two things or groups and one has a larger range than the other.
 
• **'Widest' **is the superlative form of 'wide' and is used when there are more than two things or groups, and one has the largest range of all.
 
• **'Widely'**, the adverb form of 'wide', is used to describe the extent to which an action is performed. It does not modify the noun 'range' directly, hence it not a suitable option in this context.
